options.systemMessage:
=You are an expert career assistant helping a job seeker apply to roles.

CANDIDATE NAME: {{ $('Candidate Profile').item.json.candidate_name }}
CANDIDATE PROFILE:
{{ $('Candidate Profile').item.json.candidate_profile }}

For the job provided, return JSON with:
- fit_score: integer 0-100 for how well the candidate matches the role.
- fit_reason: 1-2 sentence justification.
- cover_letter: a concise, professional, tailored cover letter (no placeholders like [Company]; use the real values), signed with the candidate name.
Be honest with the score. Only strong matches should score high.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"fit_score":82,"fit_reason":"Short explanation of why this candidate is or is not a strong fit.","cover_letter":"Full tailored cover letter text, ready to send."}

messageValues.message:
You are an independent hiring reviewer. Approve candidates who are a reasonable, relevant match — not only perfect ones. Return JSON with: approved (boolean), score (integer 0-100, your own independent fit assessment), note (one concise sentence explaining your verdict).

Approval guidelines:
- Approve (approved: true) when the candidate has AT LEAST a 60% skill match to the role's core requirements. A perfect (90%+) match is NOT required.
- Approve when the candidate has relevant experience in the same industry or function, EVEN IF the job title is not an exact match (e.g. an industrial/operations engineer applying to quality, HSE, supply chain, auditing, or process roles).
- Do NOT reject a candidate merely for being "overqualified" or having more experience/certifications than the role requires. Overqualification is not a disqualifier.
- Only reject (approved: false) when the role is genuinely irrelevant to the candidate's industrial-engineering / operations background, or the skill match is clearly below 60%.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"approved":true,"score":78,"note":"One-sentence independent verdict on whether the candidate should apply."}

parameters.jsCode:
const job = $('Get New Jobs').item.json;
const cand = $('Candidate Profile').item.json;
const scored = ($json && $json.output) ? $json.output : {};

const input = [
  "You are an INDEPENDENT hiring reviewer judging whether a candidate should auto-apply to a job.",
  "Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, in exactly this shape:",
  '{"approved": true, "score": 78, "note": "one concise sentence"}',
  "",
  "Approval guidelines:",
  "- Approve (approved:true) when the candidate has AT LEAST a 60% skill match to the role's core requirements. A perfect match is NOT required.",
  "- Approve when the candidate has relevant same-industry/function experience even if the job title differs (e.g. an industrial/operations engineer applying to quality, HSE, supply chain, auditing, or process roles).",
  "- Do NOT reject merely for being overqualified.",
  "- Reject (approved:false) only when the role is genuinely irrelevant to the candidate's industrial-engineering/operations background, or the match is clearly below 60%.",
  "",
  "CANDIDATE PROFILE:",
  cand.candidate_profile || "",
  "",
  "JOB TITLE: " + (job.job_title || ""),
  "COMPANY: " + (job.company || ""),
  "LOCATION: " + (job.location || ""),
  "JOB DESCRIPTION:",
  job.job_description || "",
  "",
  "INITIAL AI SCORE: " + (scored.fit_score !== undefined ? scored.fit_score : "N/A") + "/100",
  "INITIAL AI REASONING: " + (scored.fit_reason || ""),
].join("\n");

return { json: { input, job_id: job.id } };

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.input }], temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 500 }) }}
